pairs.question: Quid est Deus?
pairs.derivation: Authorial self-question and answer. Question begins at 'Quid est Deus?'; answer is the immediately following nominal reply 'Mens uniuersi.' (to the first full stop). Stops before the second iteration 'Quid est Deus? Quod uides totum...', which is a separate self-answer.

pairs.question: Curiosus spectator excutit singula, et quaerit. Quidni quaerat?
pairs.derivation: Self-answered question. Setup 'Curiosus spectator excutit singula, et quaerit.' kept so 'quaerat' has its referent; the operative interrogative is 'Quidni quaerat?'. Answer is the reason given immediately after, 'scit illa ad se pertinere' (capitalized as first word). Nothing trimmed; sentence ends at the full stop before '[14]'.

pairs.question: At hoc idem non faciet in flumine. Quare?
pairs.answer: Quia omnem figuram fugiens aqua disturbat.
pairs.derivation: Parenthetical self-question. Setup 'At hoc idem non faciet in flumine' (source has '(quare? ...)' as a parenthesis) is kept so 'Quare?' refers to the river not making circles; first word capitalized and dangling parenthesis normalized. Answer is the reason 'Quia omnem figuram fugiens aqua disturbat.' to the close of the parenthesis; the sentence then continues 'idem ergo in aere euenit...', which is omitted.

pairs.question: At contra ingens stagnum non amplius habebit quam unam imaginem. Quare?
pairs.answer: Quia omnis circumscripta leuitas et circumdata suis finibus speculum est.
pairs.derivation: Self-question and answer. Setup 'At contra ingens stagnum non amplius habebit quam unam imaginem' kept so 'Quare?' has its referent (why only one image). Answer is the single explanatory sentence to the full stop; what follows ('Itaque piscinam ingentis magnitudinis...') is further elaboration and is cut.

pairs.question: Quidam itaque hoc genere ualetudinis laborant, ut ipsi sibi uideantur occurrere, ut ubique imaginem suam cernant. Quare?
pairs.answer: Quia infirma uis oculorum non potest perrumpere ne sibi quidem proximum aera sed resilit.
pairs.derivation: Self-question and answer (within the reported Aristotelian discussion, but the asking and answering are authorial). Setup retained so 'Quare?' refers to those who seem to meet themselves. Answer is the single explanatory sentence to the full stop ending section [3,7]; the next sentence '[3,8] Itaque quod in aliis efficit densus aer...' is a new point and is cut.
